description: What's enforced by schema/validator vs. convention-only.
enforced: Every section's assetRole must be one of the closed enum in tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's assetRoles list — schema-closed.
Every section node must declare motion.reducedMotionFallback — schema-required.
template node sequences are a closed enum per templates/templates.json — schema-closed.
conventionOnly: Preferring semantic color roles over raw hex in new copy/markup (not machine-checked; a human/reviewer convention).
Using the 992/768/480 breakpoint set rather than Tailwind defaults for any new responsive rule.
